e0c0f8fc-ca54-5860-8eae-ee7b2aa00077.name: Abyssal Bloom Light
e0c0f8fc-ca54-5860-8eae-ee7b2aa00077.description: Daylight variant of Abyssal Bloom. Sea-foam surfaces, deep teal ink, aqua to blue gradients, cut-corner panels.
e0c0f8fc-ca54-5860-8eae-ee7b2aa00077.author: Hyacinthe

3f01befd-2d48-5783-a361-7a88697e15a3.name: Abyssal Bloom Night
3f01befd-2d48-5783-a361-7a88697e15a3.description: Bioluminescent deep-sea theme. Near-black teal, aqua glow, magenta pulse, cut-corner panels.
3f01befd-2d48-5783-a361-7a88697e15a3.author: Hyacinthe

c4f39405-c1ff-5c3b-a3bf-ea1a1b204950.name: Alabaster
c4f39405-c1ff-5c3b-a3bf-ea1a1b204950.description: Warm ivory with copper and teal, set like a printed report. Serif italics for headings, underline fields and tabs, hairline rules and double-rule bars.
c4f39405-c1ff-5c3b-a3bf-ea1a1b204950.author: Hyacinthe

95dd3482-e48a-5dff-a310-fff13a3b6a13.name: Catppuccin Mocha
95dd3482-e48a-5dff-a310-fff13a3b6a13.description: Catppuccin Mocha with a custom shell. Mantle and crust layering, candy-tinted buttons with a coloured base, mauve to pink to peach gradient on Convert, progress and checks, mono labels.
95dd3482-e48a-5dff-a310-fff13a3b6a13.author: Hyacinthe

5d256fae-22f1-5633-af82-f0fa1d7dc8f6.name: Everforest
5d256fae-22f1-5633-af82-f0fa1d7dc8f6.description: Double-ruled plates, italic serif titles, ruled-paper inputs, stamp-outline buttons that go dashed on hover, folder tabs, solid moss Convert with a pressed-down base.
5d256fae-22f1-5633-af82-f0fa1d7dc8f6.author: Hyacinthe

e08da3d8-118d-5165-a817-41ed68cc33dd.name: Kintsugi
e08da3d8-118d-5165-a817-41ed68cc33dd.description: Black lacquer, gold repair lines and vermilion seals. Serif headings, gold hairlines, underline fields, double-ruled seal buttons, round ring navigation.
e08da3d8-118d-5165-a817-41ed68cc33dd.author: Hyacinthe

74e93e8c-b842-5aba-bede-af2c0fd37e37.name: Obsidian
74e93e8c-b842-5aba-bede-af2c0fd37e37.description: Volcanic black and violet, built like a Minecraft inventory. Square bevelled slots, raised and inset edges, segmented XP-style progress bar.
74e93e8c-b842-5aba-bede-af2c0fd37e37.author: Hyacinthe

a7bf868c-aabe-567a-838e-90f148857288.name: Onyx
a7bf868c-aabe-567a-838e-90f148857288.description: Deep charcoal control panel with emerald and amber. Monospace labels, colour rails on panels and buttons, LED-segment progress, amber focus rings.
a7bf868c-aabe-567a-838e-90f148857288.author: Hyacinthe

485a6ce5-292b-59d8-a06a-59db6a498176.name: Opaline
485a6ce5-292b-59d8-a06a-59db6a498176.description: Pale lavender-white glass. Pill buttons, frosted panels with a white top highlight, opal gradient on progress and Convert.
485a6ce5-292b-59d8-a06a-59db6a498176.author: Hyacinthe

57220880-959c-527e-a074-9e8d5b379049.name: Riso Press Light
57220880-959c-527e-a074-9e8d5b379049.description: Light risograph theme. Cream paper, navy ink, blue and fluorescent pink spot colours, yellow highlighter selection, stamped edges.
57220880-959c-527e-a074-9e8d5b379049.author: Hyacinthe

5716f6bc-d838-52f0-a92c-0a80083044b2.name: Riso Press Night
5716f6bc-d838-52f0-a92c-0a80083044b2.description: Dark risograph theme. Ink-black paper, cream chalk edges, fluorescent pink and blue spot colours, yellow highlighter selection.
5716f6bc-d838-52f0-a92c-0a80083044b2.author: Hyacinthe

7bce135e-c716-5095-8e9f-8b014424bcd1.name: Shoji
7bce135e-c716-5095-8e9f-8b014424bcd1.description: Washi paper and sumi ink, with indigo titles, brown lattice hairlines and vermilion seals. The light sibling of a lacquer theme, in the spirit of a paper screen.
7bce135e-c716-5095-8e9f-8b014424bcd1.author: Hyacinthe
